brief.en: Fire lightning bolts and absorb electric charges
brief.zh: 发射球状电并吸收电荷

description.en: Ampereums fire lightning bolts at zombies and absorb electric charges from surrounding plants.
description.zh: 电离红掌向僵尸发射球状闪电，并且能吸收周围植物身上的电荷。

chat.en: Just staying together is an ordeal for the Ampereum brothers. They must resist a powerful attraction to prevent their dangerous electrical energy from canceling out the instant they touch.
chat.zh: 电离红掌兄弟光是待在一起都是一种历练，他们得抵抗强大的吸引力，防止身上危险的电能在碰到的一瞬间抵消殆尽。

text.en: lightning bolts fired after absorbing charges deal much more damages
text.zh: 吸收电荷后发射的球状电伤害更高
